scope: Standalone six-axis arm design; CNC tending and cell layout deferred

nominalReachMm.basis: UR5e/FR5 class; usable oriented workspace must be evaluated separately

peakJointSpeedDegS.qualification: Not simultaneous rated load/speed/acceleration in every configuration

poseRepeatabilityMm.verification: Measured repeated motion with calibrated external metrology; not CAD/FK residual

jointTravel.verification: Supplier physical limits, zero/sign convention, self-collision and harness review

flange.verification: Drawing/STEP agreement, pilot, bolts, dowel and normal; no generic adapter assumed qualified

dutyCycle.verification: Standalone motion duty and supplier thermal/torque-speed curves before actuator selection

commonTool.status: synthetic box; point-load mass screening excludes its intrinsic inertia

screeningAssumptions.note: Assumptions are diagnostics, not supplier ratings or commissioned travel. Sampling densities/fractions are not robot rankings.

gates.requires: Pinned official description, meshes, source frames, dimensions and limit discrepancies recorded
UR manufacturer DH oracle; FR5 source-consistency plus drawing checks, with missing independent controller oracle explicit
Oriented target grid, sampled self-clearance, Jacobian conditioning and continuous basic paths; no cell fixtures
Confirmed module codes/masses/CoGs, coupled torque-speed-duty, bearing/connection/stiffness and harness checks
Single joint and connection: measured hold/deflection/lost motion/temperature; then full-arm metrology
